email_subject: Application - Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus) at The Skateroom. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I am excited about the opportunity to bring my skills to your mission-driven brand.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, but my true passion lies in short-form video. I have been an avid TikTok user for years, and I understand what makes content scroll-stopping. I am comfortable shooting and editing on my phone using CapCut and other tools, and I have a keen eye for composition and rhythm.

I am particularly drawn to The Skateroom's blend of art, skate culture, and social impact. I would love to contribute fresh ideas and help tell your story in a way that resonates with younger audiences.

I am available for a full-time internship and can start immediately. I have attached my CV and look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am thrilled to apply for the Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus) at The Skateroom. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation and social media, I am eager to bring my creativity and technical skills to your mission-driven brand.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in content strategy, SEO, and web management. I write keyword-targeted blog posts, build and maintain WordPress sites, and analyze performance data to drive organic growth. While I enjoy the strategic side of digital marketing, my true passion lies in creating engaging short-form video content. I am a TikTok native—I spend hours on the app, not just as a viewer but as a creator. I understand the nuances of trends, memes, and what makes people stop scrolling. I am proficient in shooting and editing on my phone using CapCut and other tools, and I have a good eye for composition, rhythm, and storytelling.

What draws me to The Skateroom is the unique intersection of art, skate culture, and social impact. I have always been fascinated by how brands can use creativity to drive positive change, and I would love to contribute to your mission of empowering youth through skate projects. I am proactive, curious, and not afraid to pitch ideas. I am also comfortable jumping in front of the camera if needed.

I am available for a full-time internship and can start immediately. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am open to working from home or commuting to Brussels. I have attached my CV and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help The Skateroom tell its story through compelling video content.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
